description: Find elements by visible text, role (button, link, textbox, checkbox, combobox, option, heading, tab, menuitem, dialog, img, row, cell) or CSS selector. Returns refs you can pass to browser_act, browser_inspect or browser_screenshot, with label, state and value. Reaches inside forms, open and closed shadow roots, and elements off screen.

text.description: Visible text or accessible name to match (substring, case-insensitive).

name: browser_find
title: Find elements
